data.one_liner: Web implementation of Firebase Storage for Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides APIs to upload, download, and manage files in Firebase Storage on web browsers. It handles CORS configuration and task metadata for errors.
use_when: You need Firebase Storage support in a Flutter web app
You want to upload or download files from a web browser
avoid_when: You are targeting only mobile platforms
data.setup_notes: Add dependency, import package, initialize Firebase in main, ensure CORS headers on bucket
